messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large quadrupedal creature with the furry brown head, ears, muzzle and clawed paws of a bear combined with a glossy black segmented exoskeleton over the rest of the body. A long curved black horn with small spikes rises from a plate on top of the head. The back, neck, sides and upper legs are covered in overlapping hard dark plates with rows of oval openings along the flanks, and the four stout legs are sheathed in the same segmented armor down to the furry feet. The armored body tapers to a short pointed segmented projection at the rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with tan muzzle", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the creature"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved horn with two small spikes on the inner edge and a segmented base", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the head extending up and forward"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded brown furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the top sides of the head behind the horn base"}, {"looks_like": "small dark brown bear eyes", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping glossy black segmented plates like a beetle carapace", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back, neck, sides and upper legs from behind the head to the rear"}, {"looks_like": "rows of oval hollow openings", "part": "markings", "where": "along the sides of the neck and torso beneath the dorsal plates"}, {"looks_like": "thick stout legs encased in glossy black segmented armor", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "brown furry bear paws with long curved claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "short pointed tapering segmented extension", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear end of the body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
